name: An Adventagonistic Christmas
source:
You are one year into your 100 year transition into a mysterious celestial beast. You are six months into a midnight-black romance with Mr. Pages, a dread and nefarious member of that same race. The holidays are fast approaching, but gift-giving is illegal in Pages' culture.

Stealthily determine the best gift for your wretch of a paramour, and leave it utterly defeated by your superior show of humility, goodwill, and selfless affection.

You are going to get SUCH a good grade in romance. 

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/an-adventagonistic-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
